description: This file defines classes and functions for handling domain configurations in a Zephyr-based build system, including parsing YAML schemas, validating domain data, and managing domain objects.

classes.name: Domains
classes.description: Class for managing a collection of domain configurations, including loading from YAML or file, validation, and retrieval.

classes.name: Domain
classes.description: Data class representing a single domain with name and build directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes Domains object by parsing and validating YAML data, setting default domain and flash order.

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Loads domain data from a YAML file.

methods.name: from_yaml
methods.description: Loads domain data from a YAML string.

methods.name: get_domains
methods.description: Retrieves list of domain objects based on provided names or default flash order.

methods.name: get_domain
methods.description: Retrieves a specific domain object by name, with validation.
